name: galaxz-galaxy-boot
status: TESTING: played after boot through the UI frame's LED send; frames = the library's Galaxy (galaxz-frames), drawn on galaxy/layout.json
description: The galaxy: a sine wave rolling left to right across the OP-Z's keys (ice front, violet swirls), ending in an even fade, in the first seconds after it starts. Any animation of the library swaps in as data (the hub). See galaxy/galaxy_boot.S and OPZFirmware/Animations.swift.

edits.what: the UI frame's LED send calls the galaxy first (which then jumps on to the send)
edits.evidence: [code] 'CALL 0x8003d620' at 0x8010a9de is the UI frame's only LED send; the LED walker used the same hook on the unit (2026-11-21); 'CALL 0x80c10000' has the same size. The first try, at the boot progress 0x8002cbf0, booted but showed nothing; notes/leds.md

blocks.what: the galaxy player and its 64 frames

revert: Flash Galax-z v1 or the original (the hub, or Firmware/flash).
risk: Our code runs every UI frame (a counter check, then TE's send). If it fails, the OS fails right after boot: switch off, update mode (SCREEN), flash Galax-z v1.
